purpose: Release the PASS freeze only for individually evidenced GAP or RUNTIME-VERIFY rows after the in-flight Lite changes have converged on one main implementation baseline.
constraints: Every promotion names exactly one requirement ID and its own evidence.
The evidence records the final implementation main SHA, production implementation paths, direct assertion mapping, literal command, raw exit code, and raw pass/fail/skip counts.
A green test file, keyword match, source symbol, or old finding is not direct evidence.
PASS promotions are evaluated only after all current in-flight Lite PRs are merged into one main baseline.
DEFERRED rows and the existing pass-freeze.json remain unchanged by this authority.
New requirements, changed exit conditions, bulk promotion, and standard lowering are outside this authority.
deferredPolicy: Existing DEFERRED decisions, including LITE-04-101, do not change.
reopenCondition: Reopen an individual row only with new concrete counterevidence or when its recorded evidence is invalidated by a relevant production change.
